name: Aniesh
bio: Aniesh is an Indian film actor. He is the son of AMR Constructions Mahesh Reddy. Aniesh is slated to make his feature length acting debut in Mahesh Uppala's "Itllu Arjuna" (2026).

credits.title: Itllu Arjuna
credits.overview: A mute man with exceptional skills falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.
